saw_lines: Luxury watch buyers compare movements, heritage and case size before they buy, and often buy for a milestone.
So the sale is won or lost in the first look, where heritage and case size decide if the buyer keeps looking.
Your 16 Google creatives are all still images, so none of them shows a watch in motion. Build three video ads on Meta around the Tazio Nuvolari and Chrono 4.
